# Cisco cash-flow adjustment fixtures

Selected public inline-XBRL facts and their original contexts, units and document metadata:

- `cisco-da-2026.html`: [FY2026 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858877/000085887726000132/csco-20260725.htm), accession `0000858877-26-000132`. `csco:DepreciationAmortizationAndOther`: FY2026 $2.540B; FY2025 $2.811B; FY2024 $2.507B.
- `cisco-da-2024.html`: [FY2024 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858877/000085887724000017/csco-20240727.htm), accession `0000858877-24-000017`. Same concept: FY2024 $2.507B; FY2023 $1.726B; FY2022 $1.957B.

These are the combined cash-flow adjustments, not pure D&A. The files are minimal excerpts for deterministic regression testing. They do not expand or rerun the historical May 2026 extraction evaluation.
